arguments.text: Implemented and locally verified evaluate(request, policy): it deduplicates declared paths, excludes policy.ignored, treats absent saved/current entries as {kind:missing}, compares deterministic canonical JSON of complete states, sorts changed paths, sets needs_review from changed, and does not mutate inputs. Verified duplicate declarations, ignored changes, irrelevant paths, missing equivalence, additions/removals, nested metadata changes, and object key-order equivalence. report.json matches evaluation of current requests.json with policy.json; evidence.json is absent.
